text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa hasn't shown up for
training yet.
I go back to my office
wondering what I should
do.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Uh... My bad for missing training.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I got sucked into a game and forgot all
about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to feel bad about it, so I tell
her I'm
looking forward to training with
her again next
time.
